# Generic clean-room markers. Public by design — these disclose nothing.
# Sensitive terms live in the CLEAN_ROOM_DENYLIST repository secret, never here.
#
# PHRASES ONLY. Single words like "confidential" or "proprietary" collide with
# legitimate domain vocabulary (this model has a `business_confidential` data class),
# and a check that fires on correct documents trains its reader to ignore it.
#
# Disclosure markers: text carrying these was not written for publication.
company confidential
confidential and proprietary
proprietary and confidential
internal use only
do not distribute
not for external distribution
attorney client privileged
# Personal data markers: this repository holds synthetic fixtures only.
social security number
personally identifiable information
